name: SMART C REX PEG12-Biotin (Aldehyde Cytosine Probe)
role: Flagship SMART base reagent for Dynamic Chemical Labeling (DCL). Features an N1-formylmethyl reactive aldehyde head for reversible imine condensation and reductive amination within the abasic DGL pocket, coupled via a monodisperse PEG12 spacer to D-biotin for magnetic bead capture.
